mentions.name: safeexec
mentions.description: A safety tool for AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code that prevents destructive commands such as rm -rf or git reset --hard from being run by accident when using the --dangerously-bypass-permissions flag.
mentions.problem: AI coding agents running with bypassed permissions can accidentally execute destructive commands like rm -rf or git reset --hard.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://github.com/agentify-sh/safeexec/ - this will prevent rm -rf or git reset --hard being run by off chance when used with --dangerously-bypass-permissions flag
